heroHeading: Considered objects for a well-kept life
heroSubheading: Small-batch homeware, bags and apparel, made to be used for decades, not seasons.
aboutDescription: Aurelia began in 2019 as a two-person workshop making small runs of homeware for friends. Today we work with a handful of family-run ateliers across Europe and South Asia to make considered, long-lasting objects for the home, the wardrobe and the desk. Every product in our catalogue is made to be repaired, not replaced.
